headline: Combining Wind with Solar and Batteries Cuts Power Costs by 18%, Ember Says
summary: A report from think tank Ember Energy shows that adding wind power to solar and battery storage systems can reduce round-the-clock power costs by 18%, noting wind expansion has lagged behind rapid solar and storage adoption.
why: Ember is an independent energy think tank focused on clean energy transition data, which utilities and investors track for power generation economics.
